Civilization: Beyond Earth - Rising Tide Featurette - A New Diplomatic Landscape
I have over 800 hours in civ5, yet I get absolutely nothing from beyond earth.

Civ 5 was pretty amazing, honestly. It's hard to top that. Keep in mind that a lot of functionality of Civ 5 came from it's expansions and added features which were created after the initial release. I can see the seeds of greatness in Beyond Earth and I can see how the added diplomatic relations system will greatly increase the significance and depth of one of Civs' greatest weaknesses: AI Interaction.

Now, don't get me wrong.. I love Civ and its' little quirks. I love to tip-toe around Gandhi out of fear from his nuclear arsenal. But it gets super annoying when all of a sudden one of your allies goes all hyper aggressive and tries to fuck you in the ass. Obviously, you beat him down into submission but then everyone else sees you as the worst asshole on the planet. There are a ton of diplomatic quirks which make Civ 5 kind of annoying in that aspect.

Now, Beyond Earth is a fun game but it does lack some of the things I love about Civ 5. However, I feel that a more complex and transparent diplomacy system will only add to the fun of the game. Managing fear and respect amidst an ever changing diplomatic landscape which incorporates a deeper AI system will definitely bring Beyond Earth into the hearts of turn-based strategy gamers.

Just my two cents, however.

I don’t practice facial expressions, but I’ve tried to stop “fixing” my face when looking in the mirror.

People adjust their expression to look the most attractive in the mirror. Things like slightly narrowing their eyes (my husband is so guilty of this), or pouting a little more.
